messages:
Maya Chen: Heads-up, dashboards show a slow drift in health scores for Growth accounts starting ~03:00 UTC. Not a product outage but lots of late-arriving events from the CRM webhook queue.
Tom Brooks: I saw the retry queue spike on ingest. Looks like webhook consumer had a GC pause and replayed ~6k events out of order. Could cause triggers to be emitted after the window we expect.
Rina (CS Ops): That's dangerous  for onboarding we assume event ordering for first-touch signals. If a 'welcome_sent' arrives after 'first_success_call' it doesn't retroactively bump score.
ingest-bot: Consumer alert: webhook-consumer pod gc-pause -> 00:38:12 -> replayed 6187 events to retry-queue.
Tom Brooks: Immediate mitigation: pause automation that demotes accounts to at-risk based on "no_activity_14d" for 2 hours, so we don't double-action accounts while we replay.
Maya Chen: Agreed. Also need a backfill that synthesizes correct sequencing for affected accounts: re-run scoring window for accounts touched by the replay with the original event timestamps.
Rina (CS Ops): I'll assemble acceptance criteria: 1) No more than 0.5% net change in on_track after backfill, 2) every modified account receives a CSM note with reason, 3) playback must use original event timestamps, not arrival time.
Tom Brooks: SQL to find candidates (using retry metadata):
```
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM webhook_retry_log
WHERE retry_batch = 'gc-replay-202603'
  AND original_event_time >= now() - interval '30 days';
```
We'll export to backfill list and reprocess scoring engine with event_time precedence.
Maya Chen: Also add a guard in the playbook runner: if an event has original_event_time < existing_trigger_time for that account, skip emitting duplicate lower-priority triggers. Prevents reordering from creating false positives.
playbook-bot: Created task cs/playbooks/replay-sequencing-guard. Assigned to @Tom.
Tom Brooks: Will implement idempotency + timestamp-check: emit trigger only if original_event_time >= coalesce(existing.trigger_time, '1970-01-01'). Also include a replay tag so we can audit.
Rina (CS Ops): Backfill plan: 1) export accounts list, 2) run scoring reprocess in staging with a sample, 3) review delta and CSM notes, 4) run prod during late window with throttle 10/s.
Maya Chen: For the reprocess command we'll use the scoring runner with --use-original-timestamps flag. Example: `scoring-runner --job replay-202603 --input s3://replay/lists/gc-replay-202603.csv --use-original-timestamps --throttle 10`
Tom Brooks: Pushing a small patch to consumer to surface original_event_time in retry log and to tag replay batches. PR: https://git.redwood/ingest/pulls/582
Rina (CS Ops): I'll draft the CSM note template: "Automated correction: scoring recalculated due to webhook replay (GC pause). No action needed; contact CS Ops if you see unexpected changes."
Maya Chen: Do a staging full run first. What's the expected size? Tom?
Tom Brooks: Staging sample ~420 accounts. Full prod candidate list 5,912 accounts, predicted reclassifications ~210 (mostly yellow->green).
playbook-bot: Staging backfill queued: replay-reprocess v2 -> staging (run id rr-2201-stg).
Tom Brooks: Staging run: processed 420 accounts, reclassified 198 -> 215 green (net +17), yellow 180 -> 162 (net -18), red unchanged.
Rina (CS Ops): Staging looks fine. Acceptance checks passed. Scheduling prod run at 23:30 UTC with throttle 10/s and idempotency keys.
Maya Chen: Reminder: after reprocess, run the healthscore rollup diff and post counts here. Also leave the temporary throttle pause on the demotion automation for 3 hours.
Tom Brooks: Prod reprocess started (run id rr-2201-prod).
ingest-bot: Prod replay reprocess completed: processed 5912 accounts, reclassified 252 accounts to green, net health delta: green +252, yellow -240, red -12.
Rina (CS Ops): CSM notes attached for all modified accounts and CSV uploaded to /ops/cs/replays/2201234567-reclass.csv. Broadcast sent to #csm-team with details.
Maya Chen: Thanks. Follow-ups: 1) Add a pre-deploy test for consumer that ensures GC pause replay won't reorder timestamps (or at least preserves original_event_time), 2) add an alert if retry queue depth exceeds 1k for >5m, 3) add a playbook CI gate to simulate small reorders and measure health delta.
Tom Brooks: Will implement consumer test and queue alert. Adding replay-safe ordering check to ingest library. PRs queued.
Rina (CS Ops): Closing loop. All mitigations in place and postmortem in draft.
